categories.name: Beta - Classic Mode
categories.rules:
Complete Classic Mode with any character.
Timing starts at the Spacebar/Start input in the character menu, and ends on the last hit against Master Hand.

Top 5 runs require a video of the full run to be validated.

categories.name: Total Time
categories.rules:
Total time of all characters for the level added together. Total is shown on the character select screen.

Must include all characters up to the current version of the game: Beta 1.3.

Videos are not a requirement for this category. Screenshot proof is acceptable.

If you have your times spread out across versions, you've had times erased, etc, you may manually add up all your times for a total. A mod will also add them for you to verify it's correct.

It should be noted that times ending in .x3 or .x6 should be changed to .x33 or .x67 when adding them together, as this is how the game calculates frames when getting its version of the total. (But obviously when you get your total, it should have a 0 in the thousandths place.)

categories.name: All Characters RTA
categories.rules:
Complete the level with every character in one continuous session.

Zelda and Sheik are counted as the same character, so you only have to use 1 of them.

For v0.9b, you have to use BOTH Zelda and Sheik. This version of the game counts them as separate characters.

Requires video proof.

RTA is the timing method. Timing starts when pressing start on the character select screen, or when restarting the level on the first character. It ends when you break the last target on the last character.

Runs must be at least 25 average FPS to be verified.

values.name: Any%
values.rules:
Complete all Events with any rank. 

Timing starts when you select the first Event. Timing ends when the "SUCCESS" message pops up after beating the last event.

Stamina Glitch is banned.

values.name: All S Ranks
values.rules:
Complete all Events with an S rank. This must be done on a fresh save-file/game-file (so that you don't already have ranks and we know you're getting S).

Timing starts when you select the first Event. Timing ends when the "Congratulations! You have S-ranked every event!" message pops up, or when you get back into the Event menu and see your last S.

Stamina Glitch is banned.
